title: Interference-based XOR robustness
question: For a two-input interferometric XOR gate with uncertain phases and detector noise, determine the largest perturbation interval preserving the full truth table.
first_test: Prove optimal noise margins given fixed optical power and threshold.

title: Passive optical logic universality constraints
question: Determine whether a network of strictly passive linear optical elements and intensity thresholds can implement a complete classical logic basis without external nonlinear feedback.
first_test: Construct a universal gate network or prove a resource impossibility theorem.

title: Cascadability of photonic logic gates
question: Determine whether detector outputs from one optical logic stage can drive another stage with bounded error over arbitrary circuit depth.
first_test: Prove a regeneration condition or show noise accumulation prevents cascades.

title: Optical phase memory retention
question: For a coupled-ring photonic memory model, quantify how phase noise and dissipation limit the duration of distinguishable stored states.
first_test: Prove a storage-time bound at fixed error probability.

title: Photonic reversible gate synthesis
question: Construct a finite optical scattering network implementing a specified reversible Boolean transformation with explicit loss and detector assumptions.
first_test: Prove functional correctness and count required nonlinear resources.

title: Wave-based arithmetic precision
question: For interferometric addition of bounded integers, determine how detector resolution and phase accuracy scale with input bit width.
first_test: Establish sufficient and necessary precision bounds for one architecture.

title: Optical fan-out energy limits
question: Determine the minimum optical energy needed to copy a classical intensity-encoded bit into N reliably distinguishable outputs at fixed noise and loss.
first_test: Prove a power-splitting lower bound or give an active regeneration protocol.

title: Error accumulation in phase-coded circuits
question: Determine the scaling of worst-case output error in a depth-D cascade of phase-coded optical arithmetic operations.
first_test: Prove an error propagation theorem with saturation or correction conditions.

title: Photonic neural operator stability
question: For an optical circuit approximating a finite-dimensional linear or nonlinear operator, quantify robustness of its output to fabrication phase offsets.
first_test: Prove operator-norm error bounds and identify poorly conditioned circuits.

title: Optical versus electronic energy accounting
question: Define a full system-level energy metric including sources, modulators, detectors, memory and control, and compare one optical computation to a fixed electronic reference.
first_test: Prove an accounting identity and obtain an experimentally measurable crossover criterion.

title: Integrated photonic wavelength selection
question: Determine whether a coupled-resonator array can select a unique stable optical wavelength under a chosen saturating nonlinearity.
first_test: Prove existence and local stability of a single-mode attractor or multimode coexistence.

title: Thermal drift compensation in optical logic
question: For slowly varying temperature-dependent phase shifts, determine whether closed-loop calibration guarantees correctness of a specified optical truth table.
first_test: Prove stability of the calibration controller and failure bounds.

title: Hybrid electro-optical feedback lower bounds
question: Determine the minimum electronic feedback rate required to stabilize a noisy nonlinear optical computation against drift.
first_test: Derive a control-bandwidth condition or instability counterexample.

title: Multimode optical interference capacity
question: For M coherent input modes and bounded detector resolution, determine how many reliably distinguishable output patterns a passive network supports.
first_test: Prove an information-capacity bound under fixed photon budget.

title: Optical routing with curvature-controlled media
question: For a designed spatial refractive-index gradient, determine whether nonlinear localized pulses follow stable curved paths under perturbations.
first_test: Derive a path-tracking theorem and quantify radiation loss.

title: Wavelet-inspired optical memory addressing
question: For an optical memory array indexed by mutually overlapping resonant modes, determine whether addresses remain identifiable under mode coupling.
first_test: Prove a cross-talk bound or produce ambiguous states.

title: Pulse collision as a logic primitive
question: For two nonlinear optical pulses, determine whether their controlled collision can realize a reproducible Boolean switching operation.
first_test: Prove a robust input-output map for a fixed nonlinear waveguide model.

title: Optical error correction by redundancy
question: For a specified photonic logic channel, determine whether redundant phase encoding and thresholding suppress independent component errors with polynomial overhead.
first_test: Construct a decoder with a certified error bound or an impossibility result.

title: Photonic compiler correctness
question: Specify a typed intermediate representation for optical phase operations and prove that compilation preserves Boolean semantics in an idealized device model.
first_test: Formalize source-to-device equivalence with explicit physical assumptions.

title: Proof-carrying optical circuit calibration
question: Develop a machine-checkable certificate that measured phase and power intervals guarantee the logic table of a fabricated photonic circuit.
first_test: Prove soundness of a finite interval checker and its measurement assumptions.

title: Scaling of optical cross-talk in dense chips
question: For an array of closely spaced photonic waveguides, determine the largest density supporting an error target over a fixed propagation length.
first_test: Prove a coupling bound and derive a spacing criterion.

title: Synchronization of independent optical clocks
question: Determine whether two weakly coupled optical oscillators can maintain phase-locked computing states under bounded frequency drift.
first_test: Prove a capture-range stability condition and noise tolerance.

title: Thermodynamic efficiency of optical state reset
question: For an optical memory element coupled to a specified thermal environment, determine minimum work and photon loss required for reliable reset.
first_test: Derive a reversible-to-irreversible reset tradeoff with declared protocol constraints.

title: Full-stack verified photonic arithmetic
question: For a selected small optical arithmetic circuit, combine compiler semantics, physical noise margins and sensor calibration into an end-to-end certified correctness theorem.
first_test: Build and formally check a compositional certificate from input encoding to detected output.
